description: Create a NEW session that starts from a previous compaction snapshot of an existing session. Wraps `sessions.compaction.branch`. Use this when you want to explore an alternative continuation without losing the current session state.

id.description: Compaction snapshot id to branch from.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

sessionId.description: Source session id, when the snapshot id is ambiguous.

title.description: Title for the new branched session.

name: openclaw_sessions_compaction_branch
